events.title: GALATEA Kick-off Meeting
events.subtitle: Digital Twin for Tailored Infant Nutrition: Vision, Structure, and Implementation
events.description: The inaugural consortium meeting introduced GALATEA's scientific objectives, project structure, milestones and partner roles, with a focus on the digital twin framework for tailored infant nutrition.

events.title: Bridging Scales
events.subtitle: Computational Biophysics, Subcellular Mechanics, and Medicine
events.description: A training event on computational biophysics, molecular modelling and multiscale approaches to biomedical research, including applications in medicine and drug design.

events.title: The Role of Nutrition in Infants and Paediatric Diseases
events.subtitle: Clinics, Omics, and Molecules
events.description: An international event examining infant nutrition through clinical research, omics approaches and computational methods for characterizing human milk.

events.title: Scientific Alignment, Mobility Experiences and Network Synergies
events.subtitle: GALATEA Transfer of Knowledge Event
events.description: GALATEA beneficiaries and associated partners discussed scientific alignment across work packages, training and mobility experiences, and opportunities for collaboration.

events.title: GALATEA Mid-Term Meeting
events.subtitle: Project progress, challenges and knowledge sharing
events.description: Consortium partners, seconded staff and the Project Officer reviewed research progress, implementation milestones, mobility, dissemination and upcoming activities.

events.title: GALATEA Consortium Meeting
events.subtitle: Date to be confirmed
events.description: A GALATEA consortium meeting is planned in Gdańsk in 2027. The date, programme and further details will be announced when confirmed.
